question: What do we know about AI adoption in enterprise settings?
strategy:
1. Called get_topic_statistics → 'enterprise AI' topic not found directly
2. Called search_findings_by_keyword('enterprise') → 3 matches across 2 topics
3. Called search_findings_by_keyword('adoption') → 5 matches, overlapping with above
4. Merged results to avoid double-counting; quoted 3 most relevant findings
insights:
ANALYSIS COMPLETE
Data scope: 2 topics | 6 unique findings | 2024-01-05 to 2024-01-14
Key findings:
• 67% of Fortune 500 companies piloting AI in at least one function (2024 McKinsey survey cited)
• Biggest barriers: data quality (54%), skills gap (48%), governance uncertainty (41%)
• Productivity tools (Copilot, ChatGPT Enterprise) lead adoption; autonomous agents nascent
Trends: Rapid pilot → production gap; companies researching but slow to deploy at scale
Confidence: Medium — limited findings; recommend researcher agent expand enterprise AI coverage
